notes: 180x180 web render, PRE-MASKED (transparent squircle corners baked in — not delivered full-bleed square as a real macOS 26 icon; #1 judged on that). 1024 master unavailable; brush texture heavily anti-aliased, core hexes (measured), edge detail (estimated). glyph_type recorded as 'abstract' but is really a full wordmark — that is the #12 defect. overlay_device 'other' = diagonal leaf-midrib vein, not a tool. Three of the four non-negotiable checks (#2/#3/#4) fail: strong brand mark, weak app icon — a cautionary reference, not a model. Cover coheres in palette (black + #AFF85E + green glow halo) but pairs a refined white serif 'Leafy' logotype against the crude brush icon — two different lettering hands; the serif is the stronger asset.
